name: Samty Residential Investment Corporation
summary: Samty Residential Investment Corporation was established in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts. With Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended), with Samty Asset Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, the Asset Management Company) serving as the organizer, and was registered with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau on April 6, 2015 (registration number: Director of Kanto Local Finance Bureau No. 101). Subsequently, on June 30, 2015, Samty Residential was listed on the real estate investment trust market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (securities code: 3459).
